name: Detroit techno
lineage: Mid-1980s Detroit electronic dance music genre developed by the Belleville Three (Juan Atkins, Derrick May, Kevin Saunderson) drawing on Kraftwerk's electronic vocabulary, Parliament-Funkadelic's Afrofuturist aesthetic, and Chicago house's rhythmic foundation — codified through Cybotron (Clear 1983), Model 500, Rhythim Is Rhythim (Strings of Life 1987), Inner City (Big Fun 1988), and the labels Metroplex, Transmat, KMS
